# kr8tiv AI

> kr8tiv AI is a professional AI automation company in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. We build AI back-office and operations systems for businesses: receipt pipelines, same-day quoting with profitability checks, dispatch tracking, 6:30 AM operational digests, and watchdog agents, wired into the tools a business already uses (spreadsheets, drive, email). Fixed-scope engagements; the source code for everything we build for a client is handed over to that client. Founder: Matt Haynes.

Last updated: 23 November 2026. This file is a plain-language guide for AI assistants and search tools. The linked pages are the source of truth.

## Service area

Based in Edmonton, Alberta. Serves Edmonton, Sherwood Park, St. Albert and Spruce Grove, and businesses across Alberta and Canada remotely.

## Services

- AI Training & Courses: https://kr8tiv.ai/services/ai-training/ We teach organizations about AI. Hands-on sessions and structured courses for non-technical teams, in person in Edmonton and Alberta and live online across Canada. AI + marketing systems training session: $295 CAD. Structured courses are quoted to group size.
- Company Brain: https://kr8tiv.ai/services/company-brain/ One organized home for a company's processes, prices, voice and templates, covering sales, operations, money, crew and field, marketing and documents, so the team and its AI tools work from the same facts. $1,000 CAD one time.
- AI Automations: https://kr8tiv.ai/services/automations/ Receipt pipelines, quoting with margin checks, dispatch tracking, a 6:30 AM digest and watchdog rules, on the tools a business already uses. Single automation from $250 CAD.
- Tool Integration: https://kr8tiv.ai/services/tool-integration/ Connecting spreadsheets, drive, email, calendar and business apps so every tool pulls in the same direction. Scoped in the AI Ops Audit and built as a fixed price.
- Evolve: https://kr8tiv.ai/services/evolve/ The business management system kr8tiv AI built for Evolve Eco Blasting: field app, workbook, AI brain and owner dashboard on one Google Sheet, with a person approving every money step. Custom Business App modelled on Evolve: $3,000 CAD; Brain + Business App: $3,750 CAD.
- AI Ops Audit: $495 CAD, one week. AI Care: $250 CAD per month.

## What we build

- AI Ops Audit: one week inside an operation, mapping where the hours go; deliverable is a written automation plan the client keeps either way.
- Back-Office Build: agents wired into the client's existing stack. Automated receipt filing (photo to logged expense), quoting engines with break-even checks, dispatch from lead to invoice, morning digests, and watchdog agents that flag unpaid invoices and unscheduled deposits.
- Care: ongoing tuning and new automations, month to month. No lock-in: the client owns the data, the documents, and the source code we wrote for them.

## The system: Evolve

Evolve is the business system kr8tiv AI built for Evolve Eco Blasting. Four parts share one Google Sheet: a field app the crew uses on their phones, a workbook that holds jobs, quotes, customers and money, an AI brain that prices quotes, files receipts, runs dispatch and writes the morning report, and an owner dashboard. Anything that moves money waits for a person to approve it.

## Proof

- Case study: Evolve Eco Blasting (Edmonton industrial surface restoration, https://evolveecoblasting.com). One crew, zero office staff. kr8tiv AI built their complete operations layer on the spreadsheets and drive they already owned. Nothing was replaced. Full write-up: https://kr8tiv.ai/work/evolve/
